title: The zodiac.
lede: The twelve signs of the zodiac, in order round the year: their dates, symbols, elements and ruling planets.

card.title: The zodiac
card.desc: Twelve signs: their dates, symbols, elements and ruling planets, round the zodiac wheel.

map.label: name
map.hint: Point at a sign to see its dates. The wheel fills in as each one is mastered.

items.name: Aries
items.hook: The golden ram that flew Phrixus to safety. Its fleece became the Golden Fleece that Jason went looking for.

items.name: Taurus
items.hook: Zeus as a white bull, carrying Europa off across the sea. She gave her name to Europe.

items.name: Gemini
items.hook: Castor and Pollux. When Castor died, Pollux shared his immortality so the twins could stay together.

items.name: Cancer
items.hook: The crab Hera sent to nip Heracles while he fought the Hydra. He trod on it; Hera put it in the stars.

items.name: Leo
items.hook: The Nemean lion, whose hide no weapon could pierce: Heracles' first labour.

items.name: Virgo
items.hook: Often Astraea, goddess of justice and the last immortal to leave the Earth. Her scales hang next door, in Libra.

items.name: Libra
items.hook: The only sign that's an object rather than a creature: the scales of justice.

items.name: Scorpio
items.hook: The scorpion sent to kill the hunter Orion. They sit on opposite sides of the sky, so one sets as the other rises. Its traditional ruler is Mars.

items.name: Sagittarius
items.hook: A centaur archer, drawn with his arrow aimed at the heart of the Scorpion next door.

items.name: Capricorn
items.hook: A sea-goat, goat in front and fish behind: said to be Pan, half-changed into a fish as he fled the monster Typhon.

items.name: Aquarius
items.hook: Ganymede, the boy Zeus carried off to pour drinks for the gods. Its traditional ruler is Saturn.

items.name: Pisces
items.hook: Aphrodite and Eros, turned into fish to escape Typhon and tied together with a cord so they wouldn't lose each other. Its traditional ruler is Jupiter.
